nodes.label: Interrupt / Snooze / Trash Dispositions
nodes.rationale: Interrupt preempts the agent's turn immediately; snooze changes only when a notification is seen (batched at idle), never whether; trash is different in kind, dropping it entirely, but the file moves to a trash folder and stays in history so a too-aggressive rule stays recoverable. source=core notifications are exempt from rules.

nodes.label: First-Match-Wins Rule Ordering
nodes.rationale: Rules evaluate top to bottom and stop at the first match, making order the only precedence; add auto-places a new rule above any broader one so a narrow exception is not shadowed, and --for makes any rule temporary so a suppression cannot outlive its purpose.
